facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident - kinetic exposure at HT-9005

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9005 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. HT-9005 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 28 January 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on HT-9005 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during start-up after maintenance; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
